'''Yodel Farm''' is a shop in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]''.

Yodel Ranch can be reached via telephone and is open from 10am until 3pm every day except for Sundays and holidays. [[Rick (DS)|Rick]] sells livestock and animal accessories.
